column1: # Why the slide says 'late transition metals (Fe-Cu)' and not 'transition metals'.
# The split is INSIDE the d-block: Sc (0.83) and Cr (0.82) are the two highest scorers overall,
#   while Cu Ni Co Fe are the four lowest of all 36 cation elements.
# ** CAVEAT ** the claim is exact for the 3d row only. Ag (group 11, 4d) is also a late
#   transition metal but scores 0.44 - mid-pack. That is why the slide names the range (Fe-Cu)
#   instead of saying 'late transition metals' unqualified. Mn (group 7, 0.46) is the boundary:
#   the drop is sharp from group 8 on, which is where the bullet starts.
